title: Who's Who: Isolde Fen
summary: Layer meteorologist whose work remains part of the record of modern Eidetics.
author: Who's Who Desk
paragraphs: The Correspondent adds Isolde Fen (born 1838) to its Who's Who of Eideticians, recording a layer meteorologist whose name still attends serious discussion of the Eidetic Stratum.

Fen joined readings from several stations to identify the cycles named layer weather in 1877. Her forecasts indicate periods of unstable routes and apertures, though she refuses to call any crossing safe.
Insurance houses publish simplified versions of her tables, often omitting the large margins of uncertainty.

For Alderwick readers, Isolde Fen stands not as an ornament to legend but as a figure whose work helps explain why Eideticians prize careful terms, repeatable evidence and a sober account of what remains unknown.
